notes: Sourced from the official Rane (inMusic Brands) Seventy-Two MKII User Guide v1.4, which includes both the labeled rear/front panel connection diagrams and a consolidated "Connectors" spec table (p.102). Desktop DJ mixer, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Stereo RCA pairs (Deck 1/2 PH-CD In, Deck 1/2 Aux In, Session In, Session Out) are each two physical RCA jacks (L/R), listed individually. Mic 1/2 inputs are combo XLR/1.4" (6.35mm) TRS jacks, Mic/Line switchable (primary connector xlr3, accepts trs-6.35). Headphone outputs (1/4" TRS and 1/8" TRS) and the 1/4" TRS footswitch input are front-panel jacks but included as physical I/O per the manufacturer's own Connectors list. No connector on this device carries a bandwidth "grade" (all analog audio, USB legacy audio/MIDI at unspecified speed rather than a data-transfer-speed spec, and IEC power) so no grade fields are set. Power connector is a standard IEC (C13/C14-style) inlet, 100-240V 50/60Hz per the manual's Power spec table.
